schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_assets" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_type_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "places" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "parent_id" UUID,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "type_id" UUID,
  "name" TEXT,
  "description" TEXT,
  "latitude" REAL,
  "longitude" REAL,
  "street_number" TEXT,
  "street_name" TEXT,
  "city" TEXT,
  "region" TEXT,
  "country" TEXT,
  "postal_code" TEXT,
  "country_code" TEXT,
  "timezone" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT,
  "source" TEXT,
  "metadata" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_assets" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "place_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "asset_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "relationship" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "place_types" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT
);
